newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian shares buoyant despite budget wait.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian shares buoyant despite budget wait.

text.p: Nigerian stocks reflected anxiety over the fiscal 1997 budget on Friday, but the market still ended the week in buoyant mood.
The all-share index, which had been mostly static all week jumped on Friday to 7018.27 from 6997.82 on Thursday, mainly on speculative trading, traders said.
"All expectations are on the budget speech," said Niyi Opeodu of brokerage house Lead Investmnets Ltd.
It is not certain when exactly the budget would be broadcast but the military authorities have held some of the key meetings that usually preceed its release.
The index rose on the back of healthy price appreciation in petroleum marketing, food and bank sectors.
Unipetrol remained the dearest stock at 61.00 naira, closing 80 kobo stronger. Total was 40 kobo up at 59.10 naira
